name: v1.16.0
body:
## What's Changed

  ### Features
  * Add new rule `multiline-if-init` by @marcopeereboom in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1715
  * Add new rule `marshal-receiver` by @roidelapluie in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1707
  * `use-waitgroup-go`: support range statements by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1686
  * `line-length-limit`: add `excludes` to skip lines matching regexps by @ChrisJr404 in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1772
  * Add `specify-disable-rule` directive by @toller892 in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1739
  * Allow kebab-cased and lowercased config options by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1750
  * Export a few config functions for golangci-lint by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1753
  * Use Go 1.26; bump golangci-lint to 2.13.1 by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1777

  ### Bug Fixes
  * `use-errors-new`: disable for Go 1.26 by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1697
  * `use-any`: enable only for Go 1.18+ by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1699
  * `empty-block`: skip bare for-range loops by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1710
  * `comment-spacings`: ignore `//#nosec` directive by default by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1713
  * `add-constant`: ignore empty string literals by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1716
  * `unhandled-error`: ignore `fmt.Fprintf` with `strings.Builder` or `bytes.Buffer` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1726
  * `package-comments`: fix false positive on CRLF sources by @Eljees in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1763
  * `checkstyle` formatter: fix invalid XML for filenames with `&` or `"` by @VXNCXNX in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1770
  * Log rule internal failures instead of aborting `File.lint` by @far4599 in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1719
  * Stamp release binaries with version, commit, date and builder by @Eljees in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1764

  ### Documentation
  * Improve rules descriptions by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1671
  * Show only kebab-cased options by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1670
  * Update switch style rule arguments to kebab-case by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1676
  * Fix untyped rules descriptions by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1682
  * Improve README and RULES_DESCRIPTIONS by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1698
  * Update go instructions for modern go patterns by @denisvmedia in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1731
  * Update revive docker version by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1749
  * Add before/after examples to a batch of rule descriptions by @youdie006 in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1756
  * Add MegaLinter to the linter aggregators section by @nvuillam in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1765
  * Document Go versions for rules by @ColumbusLabs in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1766
  * Add missing `multiline-if-init` to the rules table by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1773
  * Fix lint issue; remove star history by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1768

  ### Dependency Updates
  * Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.11.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1668
  * Update module codeberg.org/chavacava/garif to v0.2.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1673
  * Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.11.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1674

  * Update module golang.org/x/sys to v0.42.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1677
  * Update module mvdan.cc/sh/v3 to v3.13.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1680
  * Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.11.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1681
  * Update module golang.org/x/mod to v0.34.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1683
  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.43.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1684
  * Update module github.com/fatih/color to v1.19.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1691
  * Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.11.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1692
  * Update module golang.org/x/text to v0.35.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1693

  * Update module mvdan.cc/sh/v3 to v3.13.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1702
  * Update golang docker tag to v1.26.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1703

  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.44.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1708
  * Update gomod by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1709

  * Update module github.com/mattn/go-isatty to v0.0.22 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1722
  * Update golang docker tag to v1.26.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1727
  * Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.12.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1725
  * Update gomod by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1730
  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.45.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1729
  * Update module golang.org/x/sys to v0.45.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1738
  * Update golang docker tag to v1.26.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1740
  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.46.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1746
  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.47.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1751
  * Update golang docker tag to v1.26.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1762
  * Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.48.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1759
  * Update module golang.org/x/mod to v0.40.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1758

  ### Chores & Internal
  * Move `isCallToExitFunction` to internal/astutils by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1688
  * Remove unused `TestGetDevelopmentVersion` for pre Go 1.24 by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1688
* Remove unused `TestGetDevelopmentVersion` for pre Go 1.24 by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1690
* Fix modernize issue; enable `package-naming` rule by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1694
* Introduce AGENTS.md by @denisvmedia in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1732
* Pin to hash versions in GitHub Actions workflows by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1733
* Fix renovate version by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1734
* Update renovate: monthly, disable indirect by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1743
* Cover `directive.specify-disable-reason` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1741
* `redundant-build-tag`: add a case with redundant go1.X by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1735
* Update rules count in `TestGetLintingRules` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1748
* Set `minimumReleaseAge` in Renovate config by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1752
* Use Go 1.26 for linting by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1774
